hooks.command: command -v discipline >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'discipline is not on PATH; the discipline hook did not run (https://orieg.github.io/discipline/)' >&2; exit 0; }; discipline hook run --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q post-tool || { echo 'discipline on PATH predates v0.22.0 (no --event post-tool); the post-tool hook did not run (https://orieg.github.io/discipline/)' >&2; exit 0; }; discipline hook run --agent agy --event post-tool

command -v discipline >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'discipline is not on PATH; the discipline hook did not run (https://orieg.github.io/discipline/)' >&2; exit 0; }; discipline hook run --agent agy --event pre-tool --observe

SessionStart.command: command -v discipline >/dev/null 2>&1 && { echo '{}'; exit 0; }; echo '{"injectSteps":[{"ephemeralMessage":"discipline is not installed or not on PATH, so the discipline hook in this repository cannot check your changes. Tell the user before you finish, so they can install it (https://orieg.github.io/discipline/)."}]}'

command -v discipline >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'discipline is not on PATH; the discipline hook did not run (https://orieg.github.io/discipline/)' >&2; exit 0; }; discipline hook run --agent agy --event session-start

Stop.command: command -v discipline >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'discipline is not on PATH; the discipline hook did not run (https://orieg.github.io/discipline/)' >&2; echo '{}'; exit 0; }; discipline hook run --agent agy --observe
